title: Let each report choose its own sink

task.text: `Report` decides which `Sink` to build with an `if` chain on a format name.
Refactor it into a **factory method**. `Reports.render(format, totals)` must keep returning exactly what it returns now, and `Sink`, `CsvSink` and `JsonSink` stay as they are.

items: `Report` becomes `abstract` with one abstract method returning a `Sink`, and a `render(Map<String, Integer>)` that calls it.
Add one subclass per format: `CsvReport` and `JsonReport`.
`Reports.forFormat(String)` returns the right `Report`; unknown formats throw `IllegalArgumentException`.

checks.title: Report is abstract with one Sink factory method
render gets its Sink from the factory method
Report never creates a concrete Sink
Report no longer stores a format name

hints.text: Find what varies: which `Sink` gets created. The rest of `render` is the same for every format. Separate the step that varies from the steps that do not.

Declare a `protected abstract Sink createSink()` in an abstract `Report`, keep `render` as the fixed algorithm that calls it, and move each `new` into `CsvReport` or `JsonReport`. Choose the subclass in `Reports`.
